title: Automation Payback
description: Rank automation candidates by payback before you build: monthly reclaimable value (hours saved per week times the loaded hourly rate, plus the error cost the automation eliminates) against total cost of ownership (one-time build amortized over the horizon, the subscription, and a maintenance haircut on recurring cost). Outputs a ranked table with break-even months and BUILD/SKIP calls, portfolio totals for hours reclaimed and net dollars, and a verdict naming the best candidate and the fastest break-even. Port of ApexLogics Apex #180 / AL-194 (page https://apexlogics.org/tools/180-automation-payback/ fetched 2026-10-13, 37945 bytes, sha256 4931C9A3713FBA69D6E614CE3BDB0FC8B01A75E7376BA8BF9916553CB2C91D1B), tasking APEXPORT-180 (GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-18, Builder-verifies-at-land 19/19 vectors), landed by APEX-PORT-180-LAND-1 on 2026-10-20. Gross-dollar arithmetic over user estimates; no tool-price database and no tax or regulatory premise.

as_of.description: Explicit as-of date YYYY-MM-DD. The kernel reads no clock; an unparseable date yields a null as_of in the output.

maintenance_haircut_pct.description: Policy parameter, not a fact: uplift on the monthly subscription only, never the amortised build. Floored at 0. Default 20 kept for live-vector parity.

horizon_months.description: Evaluation horizon in months. Rounded half-up to a whole number, then floored at 1. The build cost amortizes straight-line as build_cost / horizon_months.

weeks_per_month.description: Policy parameter, not a fact: converts hours per week to hours per month. Floored at 1. The 52/12 quotient is UNGROUNDED; default 4.33 kept for live-vector parity.

candidates.description: One entry per automation candidate. An empty array returns the zero payload with the NO_CANDIDATES flag. Every economic field is floored at 0.

name.description: Candidate label. An empty or absent name renders as Unnamed candidate.

hours_saved_per_week.description: Hours the automation returns each week. Floored at 0.

loaded_hourly_rate_usd.description: Loaded hourly value of the reclaimed time, USD. A user estimate; no wage table is stored. Floored at 0.

error_cost_avoided_usd_month.description: Monthly cost of the errors the automation eliminates, USD. A user estimate. Floored at 0.

build_cost_usd.description: One-time build cost, USD. Amortized straight-line over horizon_months. Floored at 0.

subscription_usd_month.description: Monthly subscription, USD, before the maintenance haircut. A user estimate. Floored at 0.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_automation_payback
mcp_tool_definition.description: Rank automation candidates by payback: monthly value (hours x weeks/month x loaded rate + error cost) against total cost of ownership (subscription with a maintenance haircut plus the amortised one-time build). Returns per-candidate net, break-even months and BUILD/SKIP calls, portfolio net and hours totals, and an ALL_CLEAR / MIXED_LIST / NO_CANDIDATE_CLEARS verdict. Reads no clock.

as_of.description: Explicit as-of date YYYY-MM-DD. The kernel reads no clock.

maintenance_haircut_pct.description: Policy parameter: uplift on the monthly subscription only. Floored at 0.

horizon_months.description: Evaluation horizon in whole months, rounded half-up, floored at 1.

weeks_per_month.description: Policy parameter: hours-per-week to hours-per-month. Floored at 1.

candidates.description: One entry per candidate; an empty array returns the zero payload with the NO_CANDIDATES flag.

as_of.description: Echo of the as_of input; null when unparseable.

horizon_months.description: Horizon after half-up rounding and the 1 floor.

weeks_per_month.description: Weeks per month after the 1 floor, 2dp.

ranked.description: Candidates sorted by descending net_mo, ties preserving input order.

value_mo.description: hours_saved_wk x weeks x loaded_rate + error_cost_mo.

breakeven_months.description: build_cost / (value_mo - recurring_with_haircut_mo); null when that margin is not positive. 1dp.

horizon_net.description: value_mo x horizon - (build + recurring x horizon).

net_all_mo.description: Sum of net_mo over all ranked.

hours_reclaimed_wk.description: Sum of hours over BUILD rows only, 1dp.

fastest_breakeven_candidate.description: Defined-break-even candidate with the smallest breakeven_months; net-sorted order breaks ties.
